tasks.analysis: The Erie Canal, completed in 1825, is a historic waterway in the United States that linked the Atlantic Ocean to the Great Lakes. Its construction was a remarkable engineering feat and pioneered many innovative techniques. The canal significantly reduced transportation costs and time from New York City to the interior of the nation, propelling the city into a major commercial hub.
